{{Top|leg}}
'''Enhanced humans''' were members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] whose size and strength had been increased by genetic manipulation and surgery. Around [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], a number of enhanced humans served in the [[Empire Reborn]].<ref name="CS">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref> Those individuals were most likely a product of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]]'s experiments.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
